boundaries: Fixed native-float32 full-support T32/T100 K4 d2 model, not universal convergence or recovery.
Separate T100 K20 d10 abstract inventory is not an executed solve.
Logical bytes may double-count aliases; XLA statistics and process high-water are separate.
Executable acquisitions use explicitly disabled caches; no claim about every OS/compiler reuse.

Historical PR147 full-solve entry includes initialization; this run separately compiles an initializer and an explicit-coordinate solve. Timing differences cannot be attributed solely to source changes.
No lowered IR byte size was recorded. Backend generated_code_size_in_bytes reports zero; meaningful executable byte size is unavailable.
The two measured moderate horizons do not establish scaling at the registered T6400/train5120 workload; none of its three registered recovery fits has run.
Every moderate solve used the fixed-point direction; no fallback execution or changing-parameter callable reuse was exercised by these cases.

summary_method: Reviewed validate_report independently rechecked both saved phases without optimizer calls; read_snapshot verified all payload hashes; the reviewed NumPy evaluate adapter recomputed each initial/terminal absolute energy. Scalar certificates/work are copied from saved terminal leaves. Logical group counts/bytes sum the archived leaf manifests, allowing repeated aliases. Nineteen-group mappings point directly to saved leaves. Full source/runtime/leaf/call/IR/cache records remain in the archive.
